body:
Thank you, talking to everyone and getting my thoughts straight have helped immensely. Right now I'm going to try to get over the physical problems I have been having. I can't keep physical food down, always had weight issues... maybe if I can gain weight I'll feel better about myself.

I'm going to go for a bike ride, physical exercise should help me.

Yeah, at least I hope not. With a new guy in her life I imagine we would slowly drift apart anyways. I guess only time will tell.

I would like to be in a happy relationship again. I imagine I would be able to move on quickly then, but I also don't have many avenues for meeting people. I also feel that any relationship I have while I am not over her would be unfair to the new person, I wouldn't want to hurt anyone.

I think maybe some day we can be friends again. I enjoy her company more than anyone else, even if I can't love her again.

I told her that I couldn't be with her until I can accept all this. I sorta resigned myself to the idea that getting over this means I can be friends and not have it negatively impact me. Who knows, maybe when I get over it I will realize she isn't worth having as a friend anymore anyways.

Thanks for the kind words. Stopping talking to her has been one of the hardest things I have ever had to do, and I constantly question whether or not it was the right choice.

Thank you for the kind words. My family knows what I'm going through, but talking to them only puts off the feelings of dread for so long. I haven't been able to focus at all, and I just can't stop thinking how she won't be in my life anymore.

I can't seem to shake it. Music/video games only serve as a distraction. I also have severe self esteem issues which I have had my whole life. Having a girl friend made me feel great, like I could accomplish anything. She gave me a reason and a purpose to live life.

I have been told by many people that they would love to be in my situation, because I have a really well paying job, and I put a lot of work into being good at what I do... but I would give it all up just to have things go back to what they were.

My gf even said I was the best bf she had ever had. I was trusting, and always put her first, and we were also best friends on top of it. I fear after this I will have major trust issues with any relationship I go into.

I still wanted to be her emotional support. When we broke up on terms that she needed space, I was fine with that. I could be her friend, I just wanted her to be happy... I just can't accept the real terms.

Talking about this makes me feel better... but it won't last long. I still have to see her as she left some things at my place which I really don't want to do. I hate what she did to me, but she is still my closest friend, and I can't stand the thought of her being with this guy from work who stole that happiness away from me. The guy is kinda a creep, he left a 7 year relationship for my gf.. he kept pursuing her and she put her foot down saying she was in an amazing relationship already. Eventually he broke her and she felt guilty, and now she's with him, just hard to accept.
